Yuma - Business Analyst H/F/X
Référence 5898755
|
Créé le 14 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Independant
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Description de l'entreprise
Smart, Lean, Agile.
Yuma is an established ICT consultancy that steers the strategy and ICT transformation aimed at boosting your organization's performance, productivity and competitiveness. We combine deep expertise with understanding, experience and end-to-end capabilities across all industries, from consulting to solution delivery, achieving a 96% client retention rate.
Our mission? We develop and implement ICT solutions to improve the productivity, efficiency and profitability of clients, enabling them to become high-performance organizations in the face of disruptive market change.
Description de la fonction
For our clients across the public and private sectors, we are looking for a Senior Business Analyst to strengthen a team responsible for application evolution projects and the implementation of new ways of working linked to the gradual resumption of operational activities.
At Yuma, we believe technology only matters when it makes a real difference for people.
What you'll do
You will play a key role in bridging business needs and IT solutions, ensuring clarity, structure, and value delivery throughout the project lifecycle
Understand, analyze, and formalize business needs in close collaboration with stakeholders
Translate business requirements into clear and structured functional specifications
Conduct detailed functional analyses in the context of application evolutions and continuous improvements
Participate in refinement workshops, offer analysis, and contribute to the drafting of project deliverables
Organize and facilitate meetings and workshops to capture specific needs and document them in structured analysis files
Support testing activities and contribute to validation processes
Profile / requirements
Who you are :
You are a Senior Business Analyst with strong analytical skills and the ability to structure complex information into clear, actionable insights. You are comfortable interacting with multiple stakeholders and translating operational needs into functional solutions.
Additionally, you bring
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies
Solid understanding of project management principles
Experience with modeling techniques (UML / BPMN)
Experience using Enterprise Architect
Good knowledge of SQL
Experience in testing / validation activities
Excellent oral and written communication skills in French
Strong synthesis skills and the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and accessible way
Why Yuma ?
At Yuma, you're given space. Space to grow, to experiment, and to shape your own path. We have a strong focus on knowledge sharing. You will work on complex digital challenges in teams where collaboration and curiosity are key.
